mission.objective: Implement prospectively registered trusted local host scientific adapter without changing frozen science.

instructions.context: Implement only new package files in this isolated workdir. Parent repository when deployed is Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]. reference/ contains immutable PUBLIC reference source, not importable deployment code. Do not change reference files. Never execute any real C or D operation; implementation and unit tests with temp synthetic inputs only. Full engineering is authorized; parent orchestrator handles gates and execution.
requirements: Create __init__.py, trusted_host.py, test_trusted_host.py and reproduce.ps1. Use existing paper12_singleowner1 scientific_evaluator.evaluate unchanged and custodian_producer.validate_catalog unchanged via normal package imports. Use common validators and frozen_math exact. No cryptographic authority/ledger/controller, no new security subsystem. Mode SYNTHETIC or REAL explicit; evaluator manifest remains REAL C so its raw flags must be wrapped with actual source lineage (synthetic D flag must stay false for real evaluation).

CLI stages: preflight --output newdir validates registration source_sha256, base HEAD, all original scientific hashes, full 1862-file C inventory paper12_cseal1/.private/sealed_C_recovery_1 versus complete_seal_inventory.json sha256; calls validate_state_manifest; uses real_metadata.materialize(output/metadata) public frozen metadata then validate_catalog body realm REAL_D. Checks original complete_C seal counts/provenance; validates D original final_D_partition_manifest against generated partition IDs (inspect JSON dynamically, no guessing). Output public PASS receipt with source/file/manifest hashes,13 identities,290 cases,13 coverage, no raw C/D reads and no refits. No protected D cipher/key read until real stage. Full C validator reads fitted states only, authorized.

CLI synthetic --preflight <dir> --output newdir: reuse real C sealed bundle paths (no changes) but evaluator binding needs all C artifacts plus public metadata: create own binding directory with copies C files and copied metadata. Avoid copying C_state_manifest twice. Generate synthetic source catalog envelopes with exact production real metadata shape/trials/unit ordering, original full source units, constant sentinel for unselected units, deterministic default_rng(20261015). Keep source catalog context unchanged and body REAL_D for validator even in SYN mode; explicit synthetic-only source roots must point into run output/private/synthetic_sources, never original roots; original ciphertext hashes differ thus validate original catalog BEFORE synthetic override and pass actual D decoding helper typed catalog via strict already-validated metadata. All source tuple inputs immutable and path-safe; exact original source parser AEAD envelope/AAD/shape/unit-order/selection logic as reference producer, no security-context bypass through monkeypatching. Keep synthetic envelopes/private paths ignored. Run same new producer adapter and exact evaluator over all290 cases/all104x999 suites, original wall limit43200, no stubbing, subsampling or mocked evaluator.

CLI real --preflight <dir> --synthetic <completed synthetic run> --output newdir: checks preflight/source hashes still exact, full synthetic receipts completeness,mice13,cases290,null_evaluations103896, finite stats and no new fits. Atomic real reservation single fixed file paper12_sciencefinal1/private/REAL_D_RESERVED.json with x+fsync before any real key/cipher open; no delete/reset/resume API. Refuse if exists even incomplete. Binding uses original fullC states/copied original public metadata and original source roots; call validate_catalog. Decrypt only frozen D.gcm using original32-byte D.key; original P12GCM1\0 envelope/AAD/frombuffer<u4 and size checks; select frozen 32unit CA1/DG and exact D240 trials; write delivery exact fields+hashes+expected body fields matching evaluator. No new fits or reading raw C. Never log keys/count arrays in public outputs. Original protected source not copied or modified. New output path private delivery and separate public result. Keep all outputs append-only. Preserve exceptions as technical failure receipts; never auto retry.

CLI never accepts arbitrary paths or mode aliases that can mistake REAL source as synthetic. Synthetic actual sources must be descendants synthetic directory plus canary check; real sources must equal metadata source_roots.json exact. Verify shape,finite score,mask,unit order,hashes. No C modifications, sys.path/sys.modules patches, monkeypatching security/scientific validators. Public preflight copies only receipts/metadata; work binding and delivery stay private (ignored git). After complete evaluation, write explicit run_receipt with mode,source lineage,scientific_evaluation_executed(modeREAL),gate(scientific execution not positive hypothesis),all counts,source and output hashes. Do not claim overall scientific validation true just from execution.

Add meaningful unit tests with no real inputs: authenticated decrypt/source hash/shape/context/select exact, wrongkey/alteredcipher/context/path/duplicate/runreservation denial; synthetic-real source separation; exact scientific verdict boundary tests or re-use existing ScientificTests. Unit tests must work from repository root with python -B -m unittest paper12_sciencefinal1.test_trusted_host. Preflight is NOT automatically invoked at import. PowerShell saved-only default verifies all saved public result hashes & reaggregates frozen stats; never executes real stage by default. Explicit real CLI remains parent-only after gates. Include a public RUNBOOK.md and clearly no online signer/publickey requirement. Do not implement manuscript until actual outcomes available.
constraints: No actual protected neural experiments, no external network, no Git commands, no editing references or outside staging workspace
Do not claim tests performed unless executed; no imported private key signer; never create REAL data or entitlement in code-writing stage

criteria: Source preserves scientific evaluator byte identity and exact original requirements
No dropped/null suite reductions; all unit code tested where stage supports it
